user.title: SmartHeat Login
user.description: Sign in with your existing SmartHeat account or register at <placeholder for website link>.

tenant.title: Select installation
tenant.description: The dropdown lists every heating installation linked to your account. Which one would you like to set up?

profile.title: Select profile
profile.description: Choose the three properties of your heating system: manufacturer, heat source, and heat distribution. The matching profile is determined automatically from this combination.

entities.title: Map entities
entities.description: Assign the matching Home Assistant entity to each role so the heating curve control can access the correct sensors and actuators.

retry_push.title: Could not configure add-ons
retry_push.description: MQTT credentials (apply manually if this keeps failing): {mqtt_username} / {mqtt_password}

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SmartHeat service
error.no_tenants: Subscribe on our website to get access to our heating control server.
error.profile_combination_unsupported: This combination is not supported yet

abort.not_supervisor: This integration only works on a Home Assistant installation with Supervisor (Home Assistant OS or Home Assistant Supervised), because it provisions real MQTT credentials and configures companion add-ons via the Supervisor API.
abort.already_configured: This installation is already configured. Remove the existing SmartHeat config entry first if you want to reconfigure it.
